summary: Hall County facility page + campground map: 97 water/50-amp RV-or-tent sites + 14 primitive (count 88 -> 97), showers, laundry, dump, spigots, beach, boat ramp; books on Hall County's Itinio site (human-verification image check, not passed, so no rates). AWH note kept verbatim, but its '88 sites' is Bolding Mill's figure (see flag). Season left unset: the county page states two different seasons. Pin ~500 m off at the entrance road; phone field has two numbers.
flags: AWH note says 'Many of the 88 sites have 180-degree lake views directly on the water' (word-for-word Bolding Mill's note). Duckett Mill has 97 water/electric sites plus 14 primitive, 111 in all ('97 Multiuse Sites - RV & Tent with water/electric', '14 Primitive Tent Camping Sites', '111 spacious campsites'). Note kept verbatim; AWH may want '88' changed to 97 (or 111).
Phone field holds two numbers (770-533-7235,770-532-9802). The county facility page and the campground map give '(770)533-7235' only. Suggest 770-533-7235.
Season conflict on the county's own page: the header says 'Camping Season: End of March through November', the description below says 'Camping Season: Year-round'. Season left unset.

Pin ~500 m off: stored 34.3071,-83.9317 sits on the entrance road north-east of the swim beach, near the gate. The site loops spread over the peninsulas south-west of the beach; imagery matched to the county map puts the campground's centre at about 34.3035,-83.9352. Suggest that; elevation_meters needs re-fetching.

Fees still unset: Hall County publishes no camping rates, and the Itinio reservation page shows a 'Let's confirm you are human' image challenge ('Choose all the buckets') before any site list, which I did not attempt to solve.
